responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust intrinsic-ABI functions into synthetic GCC function decls and bodies. It dispatches intrinsic names to handlers for size/offset/transmute-style operations, rotates and wrapping or unchecked arithmetic, memory and prefetch helpers, and atomic load/store families; validates monomorphized operand types; reuses cached intrinsic decls; and, where appropriate, binds Rust intrinsics to previously registered GCC builtins to emit the required backend calls or expressions.
same_name_distinction: Implements intrinsic lowering by dispatching intrinsic names to handlers, synthesizing intrinsic function bodies, validating operand types, caching compiled decls, and bridging some intrinsics to BuiltinsContext-registered GCC builtins such as atomic operations and prefetch. Unlike the header, it contains the intrinsic registry and handler logic, not just the small wrapper class declaration.
